player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} ni {max_rounds} hpun Kuhn Poker hpun kawp kaw sa.
Hpun Gawng:
- Kuhn Poker ni 3-hkaipawt hte J, Q, K (J hpan, K hpun kawp) hte shtu
- Shi hte shi hkan {ante} chip shahte hte 1-hkaipawt kawp kaw sa hpun kawp hte (hkaipawt ni shi hte shi hkan n re ai, nang kawp kaw sa hte nang hte shi hkan hkaipawt n re ai)
- Hpun kawp {max_rounds} hpun kawp sa
- Shi hte shi hkan chip shagu hte hpun kawp kaw sa hte shi hte shi hkan chip shagu hte n re ai hte shi hte shi hkan hpun kawp sa
Action Gawng:
- '[check]': N re ai hte bet n re ai hte shi hte shi hkan (shi hte shi hkan n re ai hte bet n re ai hte)
- '[bet]': 1 chip shahte hte pot hte (shi hte shi hkan n re ai hte bet n re ai hte)
- '[call]': Shi hte shi hkan bet hte 1 chip shahte hte pot hte
- '[fold]': Nang kawp kaw sa hte shi hte shi hkan hpun kawp sa
